notes.forged: The last append with its data changed after signing: it must not verify, and is never held or laid.
notes.have: The tiles.get have that holds the closed tile: the service answers it with the pieces alone.
notes.laid: What Lay makes of the named tiles, in that order. A trailing tile stays partial; its etag is that of the data as laid.
notes.tiles: One tile of each shape, in the order the box sends them, signed by boxKey. Each passes Tiles.Check.
